+      context,
+      height: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * .9,
+      keyboardAware: true,
+      barrierDismissible: false,
+      enableDrag: false,
+      showDragHandle: true,
+      builder: (_) => const _AnonymousIdentityContent(sheet: true),
+    );
+
+class AnonymousIdentityPage extends StatelessWidget {
+  const AnonymousIdentityPage({super.key});
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
+    appBar: GfAppBar(
+      title: GfText(AppLocalizations.of(context).anonymousIdentity),
+    ),
+    body: const SafeArea(top: false, child: _AnonymousIdentityContent()),
+  );
+}
+
+class _AnonymousIdentityContent extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
+  const _AnonymousIdentityContent({this.sheet = false});
+  final bool sheet;
+  @override
+  ConsumerState<_AnonymousIdentityContent> createState() =>
+      _AnonymousIdentityContentState();
+}
+
+class _AnonymousIdentityContentState
+    extends ConsumerState<_AnonymousIdentityContent> {
+  bool busy = false;
+  Object? error;
+  String? pendingKey, pendingDay, activeBatchId;
+  bool historyOpen = false;
+  ({String batchId, int index, String word})? choice;
+  late final int epoch;
+  AnonymousIdentityRepository get repo =>
+      AnonymousIdentityRepository(ref.read(apiClientProvider));
+  @override
+  void initState() {
+    super.initState();
+    epoch = ref.read(offlineCacheEpochProvider);
+  }
+
+  bool get current => mounted && epoch == ref.read(offlineCacheEpochProvider);
+  String date(DateTime value) => DateFormat.yMMMd(
+    AppLocalizations.of(context).localeName,
+  ).add_Hm().format(value.toLocal());
+
+  Future<void> run(
+    Future<void> Function() action, {
+    bool refresh = true,
+  }) async {
+    if (busy || !current) return;
+    setState(() {
+      busy = true;
+      error = null;
+    });
+    try {
+      await action();
+      if (current && refresh) ref.invalidate(anonymousIdentityProvider);
+    } catch (e) {
+      if (current) setState(() => error = e);
+    } finally {
+      if (current) setState(() => busy = false);
+    }
+  }
+
+  Future<void> draw(AnonymousIdentityState state) => run(() async {
+    if (pendingDay != state.day) {
+      pendingKey = null;
+      pendingDay = state.day;
+    }
+    pendingKey ??= newTopicDraftKey();
+    final batch = await repo.generate(state.day, pendingKey!);
+    if (current) {
+      pendingKey = null;
+      activeBatchId = batch.id;
+      choice = null;
+      historyOpen = false;
+    }
+  });
+
+  Future<void> confirm() async {
+    final selected = choice;
+    if (selected == null) return;
+    await run(() async {
+      final persona = await repo.confirm(selected.batchId, selected.index);
+      if (!mounted || !current) return;
+      choice = null;
+      if (widget.sheet) {
+        ref.invalidate(anonymousIdentityProvider);
+        Navigator.of(context).pop((persona: persona, openProfile: false));
+      }
+    }, refresh: !widget.sheet);
+  }
+
+  void close() {
+    if (!busy) Navigator.of(context).maybePop();
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    ref.listen(offlineCacheEpochProvider, (_, next) {
+      if (next != epoch && mounted) {
+        if (widget.sheet) {
+          Navigator.of(context).pop();
+        } else {
+          GoRouter.maybeOf(context)?.go('/');
+        }
+      }
+    });
+    final l = AppLocalizations.of(context);
+    final colors = GfTheme.colorsOf(context);
+    final type = GfTheme.typographyOf(context);
+    final state = ref.watch(anonymousIdentityProvider);
+    if (!current) return const SizedBox.shrink();
+    final s = state.valueOrNull;
+    final canChoose =
+        s != null && !s.locked && !s.disabled && !s.governanceDisabled;
+    final batch = s == null || s.batches.isEmpty
+        ? null
+        : s.batches.where((b) => b.id == activeBatchId).firstOrNull ??
+              s.batches.last;
+    // Midnight invalidates yesterday's preview as well as its request key.
+    final selected = choice?.batchId == batch?.id ? choice : null;
+    final muted = colors.baseContent.withValues(alpha: .65);
+    return PopScope(
+      canPop: !busy,
+      child: LayoutBuilder(
+        builder: (context, box) {
+          // Short sheets (large text, open keyboard) keep only the button
+          // pinned; the lock hint moves into the scrolling body.
+          final compact = box.maxHeight < 560;
+          return Column(
+            children: [
+              if (widget.sheet) ...[
+                Padding(
+                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 12, 12, 12),
+                  child: Row(
+                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+                    children: [
+                      Expanded(
+                        child: GfText(
+                          s?.persona == null
+                              ? l.anonymousSetup
+                              : l.anonymousManage,
+                          style: type.title3,
+                        ),
+                      ),
+                      GfIconButton(
+                        symbol: 'x',
+                        tooltip: l.commonClose,
+                        onPressed: busy ? null : close,
+                      ),
+                    ],
+                  ),
+                ),
+                const GfDivider(),
+              ],
+              Expanded(
+                child: s == null
+                    ? Center(
+                        child: state.hasError
+                            ? Padding(
+                                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
+                                child: Column(
+                                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
+                                  children: [
+                                    GfText(
+                                      resolveErrorMessage(l, state.error!),
+                                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
+                                      style: type.body,
+                                    ),
+                                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
+                                    GfButton(
+                                      label: l.anonymousRetry,
+                                      variant: GfButtonVariant.secondary,
+                                      onPressed: () => ref.invalidate(
+                                        anonymousIdentityProvider,
+                                      ),
+                                    ),
+                                  ],
+                                ),
+                              )
+                            : const CircularProgressIndicator(),
+                      )
+                    : ListView(
+                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
+                        children: [
+                          GfText(
+                            l.anonymousPurpose,
+                            style: type.body.copyWith(color: muted),
+                          ),
+                          const SizedBox(height: 20),
+                          if (error != null || state.hasError) ...[
+                            Semantics(
+                              liveRegion: true,
+                              child: GfText(
+                                resolveErrorMessage(l, error ?? state.error!),
+                                style: type.body.copyWith(color: colors.error),
+                              ),
+                            ),
+                            GfButton(
+                              label: l.anonymousRetry,
+                              variant: GfButtonVariant.ghost,
+                              onPressed: busy
+                                  ? null
+                                  : () => ref.invalidate(
+                                      anonymousIdentityProvider,
+                                    ),
+                            ),
+                            const SizedBox(height: 16),
+                          ],
+                          if (s.persona case final p?) ...[
+                            // One inset group keeps the persona and its
+                            // switches on a shared edge.
+                            Material(
+                              key: const ValueKey('anonymous-persona-card'),
+                              color: colors.base200.withValues(alpha: .6),
+                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
+                              clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
+                              child: Column(
+                                children: [
+                                  GfSettingRow(
+                                    leading: GfAvatar(
+                                      src: resolveApiAssetUrl(p.avatarUrl),
+                                      size: 44,
+                                    ),
+                                    title: p.name,
+                                    description: s.governanceDisabled
+                                        ? l.anonymousRestricted
+                                        : s.disabled
+                                        ? l.anonymousInactive
+                                        : l.anonymousReady,
+                                    trailing: const GfSymbol(
+                                      'chevron-right',
+                                      size: 18,
+                                    ),
+                                    onTap: busy
+                                        ? null
+                                        : () {
+                                            if (widget.sheet) {
+                                              Navigator.of(context).pop((
+                                                persona: p,
+                                                openProfile: true,
+                                              ));
+                                            } else {
+                                              GoRouter.maybeOf(
+                                                context,
+                                              )?.push(p.profileUrl);
+                                            }
+                                          },
+                                  ),
+                                  const GfDivider(inset: 16),
+                                  GfSwitchRow(
+                                    title: l.anonymousShowContent,
+                                    description:
+                                        l.anonymousShowContentDescription,
+                                    value: s.showContent,
+                                    onChanged: (value) {
+                                      if (!busy) {
+                                        run(
+                                          () => repo.setProfileContent(value),
+                                        );
+                                      }
+                                    },
+                                  ),
+                                  const GfDivider(inset: 16),
+                                  if (s.governanceDisabled)
+                                    GfSettingRow(
+                                      title: l.anonymousActiveLabel,
+                                      subtitleWidget: GfText(
+                                        l.anonymousStatusRestricted,
+                                        style: type.caption.copyWith(
+                                          color: colors.error,
+                                        ),
+                                      ),
+                                    )
+                                  else
+                                    GfSwitchRow(
+                                      title: l.anonymousActiveLabel,
+                                      description: l.anonymousDisabledHint,
+                                      value: !s.disabled,
+                                      onChanged: (active) {
+                                        if (!busy) {
+                                          run(() => repo.setDisabled(!active));
+                                        }
+                                      },
+                                    ),
+                                ],
+                              ),
+                            ),
+                            if (s.locked) ...[
+                              const SizedBox(height: 8),
+                              Padding(
+                                padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(
+                                  start: 16,
+                                ),
+                                child: GfText(
+                                  l.anonymousLockedUntil(date(s.availableAt!)),
+                                  style: type.caption.copyWith(color: muted),
+                                ),
+                              ),
+                            ],
+                            const SizedBox(height: 24),
+                          ],
+                          if (canChoose) ...[
+                            _NameStage(
+                              caption: l.anonymousPreviewCaption,
+                              name: selected?.word,
+                              placeholder: l.anonymousPreviewPlaceholder,
+                              tag: l.anonymousTag,
+                            ),
+                            const SizedBox(height: 16),
+                            if (batch == null) ...[
+                              GfText(
+                                l.anonymousIntroTitle,
+                                style: type.bodyStrong,
+                              ),
+                              const SizedBox(height: 4),
+                              GfText(
+                                l.anonymousIntroBody,
+                                style: type.body.copyWith(color: muted),
+                              ),
+                            ] else ...[
+                              Row(
+                                children: [
+                                  Expanded(
+                                    child: GfText(
+                                      l.anonymousChooseName,
+                                      style: type.bodyStrong,
+                                    ),
+                                  ),
+                                  if (s.batches.length > 1)
+                                    Flexible(
+                                      child: _HistoryToggle(
+                                        label: l.anonymousBatchOf(
+                                          s.batches.indexOf(batch) + 1,

+                                        ),
+                                        semanticsLabel:

+                                        open: historyOpen,
+                                        onPressed: busy

+                                            : () => setState(

+                                              ),
+                                      ),
+                                    ),
+                                ],
+                              ),
+                              AnimatedSize(
+                                duration:
+                                    MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)
+                                    ? Duration.zero
+                                    : const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
+                                curve: Curves.easeOut,
+                                alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
+                                child: historyOpen && s.batches.length > 1
+                                    ? Padding(
+                                        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
+                                        child: _HistoryMenu(
+                                          batches: s.batches,
+                                          activeId: batch.id,
+                                          title: l.anonymousPreviousBatches,
+                                          numberLabel: l.anonymousBatchNumber,

+                                          }),
+                                        ),
+                                      )
+                                    : const SizedBox(width: double.infinity),
+                              ),
+                              const SizedBox(height: 12),
+                              // One fade per batch keeps a new draw noticeable
+                              // without animating every option.
+                              AnimatedSwitcher(
+                                duration:
+                                    MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)
+                                    ? Duration.zero
+                                    : const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
+                                switchInCurve: const Cubic(.2, 0, 0, 1),
+                                switchOutCurve: Curves.easeOut,
+                                child: LayoutBuilder(
+                                  key: ValueKey(batch.id),
+                                  builder: (context, constraints) => Wrap(

+                                        i++

+                                        SizedBox(
+                                          width: (constraints.maxWidth - 8) / 2,
+                                          child: _NameOption(

+                                          ),
+                                        ),
+                                    ],
+                                  ),
+                                ),
+                              ),
+                              const SizedBox(height: 12),
+                              GfText(
+                                l.anonymousDrawsRemaining(s.remaining),
+                                style: type.caption.copyWith(color: muted),
+                              ),
+                            ],
+                            if (compact && batch != null) ...[
+                              const SizedBox(height: 4),

+                                l.anonymousNameLockHint,

+                            const SizedBox(height: 24),

evidence.detail:
diff --git a/apps/mobile/packages/forum_app/lib/src/pages/settings/profile_privacy_page.dart b/apps/mobile/packages/forum_app/lib/src/pages/settings/profile_privacy_page.dart
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..8c2fa3344
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/mobile/packages/forum_app/lib/src/pages/settings/profile_privacy_page.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,367 @@
+import 'package:core/core.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
+import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
+import 'package:ui_kit/ui_kit.dart';
+
+import '../../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../current_user.dart';
+import '../../navigation/auth_navigation.dart';
+import '../../providers.dart';
+import '../../widgets/skeletons.dart';
+import '../../widgets/status_views.dart';
+
+/// The owner's saved profile privacy (issue #1124), reloaded per login epoch.
+final profilePrivacySettingsProvider =
+    FutureProvider.autoDispose<UserPrivacySettingsPayload?>((ref) async {
+      ref.watch(offlineCacheEpochProvider);
+      if (await ref.watch(currentUserProvider.future) == null) return null;
+      return ref.read(userRepositoryProvider).getPrivacySettings();
+    });
+
+const List<String> _audienceRank = [
+  'everyone',
+  'members',
+  'followers',
+  'mutual',
+  'self',
+];
+
+/// True when [to] lets more people see a section than [from].
+bool profilePrivacyWidens(String from, String to) =>
+    _audienceRank.indexOf(to) < _audienceRank.indexOf(from);
+
+String profilePrivacySectionLabel(AppLocalizations l10n, String key) =>
+    switch (key) {
+      'profileTopics' => l10n.profilePrivacyTopics,
+      'profileActivity' => l10n.profilePrivacyActivity,
+      'profileLikes' => l10n.profilePrivacyLikes,
+      'followingList' => l10n.profilePrivacyFollowing,
+      _ => l10n.profilePrivacyFollowers,
+    };
+
+String _sectionDescription(AppLocalizations l10n, String key) => switch (key) {
+  'profileTopics' => l10n.profilePrivacyTopicsDescription,
+  'profileActivity' => l10n.profilePrivacyActivityDescription,
+  'profileLikes' => l10n.profilePrivacyLikesDescription,
+  'followingList' => l10n.profilePrivacyFollowingDescription,
+  _ => l10n.profilePrivacyFollowersDescription,
+};
+
+String profilePrivacyAudienceLabel(AppLocalizations l10n, String audience) =>
+    switch (audience) {
+      'members' => l10n.profilePrivacyMembers,
+      'followers' => l10n.profilePrivacyFollowersOnly,
+      'mutual' => l10n.profilePrivacyMutual,
+      'self' => l10n.profilePrivacySelf,
+      _ => l10n.profilePrivacyEveryone,
+    };
+
+/// Choose who can see each profile section. A row shows the saved value
+/// until the server confirms a change, so a failure needs no rollback.
+class ProfilePrivacyPage extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
+  const ProfilePrivacyPage({super.key});
+
+  @override
+  ConsumerState<ProfilePrivacyPage> createState() => _ProfilePrivacyPageState();
+}
+
+class _ProfilePrivacyPageState extends ConsumerState<ProfilePrivacyPage> {
+  UserPrivacySettingsPayload? _confirmed;
+  String? _saving;
+
+  Future<void> _choose(UserPrivacySettingsPayload settings, String key) async {
+    if (_saving != null) return;
+    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
+    final current = settings.audienceOf(key);
+    final epoch = ref.read(offlineCacheEpochProvider);
+    final picked = await showGfBottomSheet<String>(
+      context,
+      showDragHandle: true,
+      builder: (_) => _AudienceSheet(section: key, selected: current),
+    );
+    if (!mounted ||
+        picked == null ||
+        picked == current ||
+        epoch != ref.read(offlineCacheEpochProvider)) {
+      return;
+    }
+    // Restoring a wider audience re-exposes history, so confirm it first.
+    if (profilePrivacyWidens(current, picked) &&
+        !await _confirmWiden(l10n, key, picked)) {
+      return;
+    }
+    if (!mounted || epoch != ref.read(offlineCacheEpochProvider)) return;
+    setState(() => _saving = key);
+    try {
+      final saved = await ref
+          .read(userRepositoryProvider)
+          .updatePrivacySetting(key, picked);
+      if (!mounted || epoch != ref.read(offlineCacheEpochProvider)) return;
+      setState(() => _confirmed = saved);
+      showGfToast(context, l10n.profilePrivacySaved);
+    } catch (_) {
+      if (mounted && epoch == ref.read(offlineCacheEpochProvider)) {
+        showGfToast(context, l10n.profilePrivacySaveFailed, error: true);
+      }
+    } finally {
+      if (mounted) setState(() => _saving = null);
+    }
+  }
+
+  Future<bool> _confirmWiden(
+    AppLocalizations l10n,
+    String key,
+    String audience,
+  ) async =>
+      await showGfAlertDialog<bool>(
+        context,
+        barrierDismissible: true,
+        builder: (ctx) => GfAlertDialog(
+          key: const ValueKey('profile-privacy-widen'),
+          title: Text(l10n.profilePrivacyWidenTitle),
+          content: Text(
+            l10n.profilePrivacyWidenDescription(
+              profilePrivacySectionLabel(l10n, key),
+              profilePrivacyAudienceLabel(l10n, audience),
+            ),
+          ),
+          actions: [
+            GfButton(
+              label: l10n.commonCancel,
+              variant: GfButtonVariant.ghost,
+              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
+            ),
+            GfButton(
+              label: l10n.profilePrivacyWidenConfirm,
+              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
+            ),
+          ],
+        ),
+      ) ==
+      true;
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
+    // A different account never inherits the previous one's saved values.
+    ref.listen(offlineCacheEpochProvider, (_, _) {
+      setState(() {
+        _confirmed = null;
+        _saving = null;
+      });
+    });
+    final state = ref.watch(profilePrivacySettingsProvider);
+    return Scaffold(
+      appBar: GfAppBar(title: Text(l10n.profilePrivacyTitle)),
+      body: SafeArea(
+        top: false,
+        child: state.when(
+          loading: () => const GfSettingsSkeleton(),
+          error: (error, _) => GfErrorRetry(
+            message: l10n.profilePrivacyLoadFailed,
+            onRetry: () => ref.invalidate(profilePrivacySettingsProvider),
+          ),
+          data: (loaded) => loaded == null
+              ? GfEmpty(
+                  symbol: 'login4',
+                  message: l10n.profileNotLoggedIn,
+                  action: GfButton(
+                    label: l10n.authLoginTitle,
+                    onPressed: () => context.push(
+                      authLoginLocation(returnTo: '/settings/profile-privacy'),
+                    ),
+                  ),
+                )
+              : _content(context, l10n, _confirmed ?? loaded),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+
+  Widget _content(
+    BuildContext context,
+    AppLocalizations l10n,
+    UserPrivacySettingsPayload settings,
+  ) {
+    final colors = GfTheme.colorsOf(context);
+    final type = GfTheme.typographyOf(context);
+    final muted = type.caption.copyWith(
+      color: colors.baseContent.withValues(alpha: .65),
+    );
+    final keys = profilePrivacyAudiences.keys.toList();
+    return ListView(
+      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
+      children: [
+        Padding(
+          padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start: 4, bottom: 12),
+          child: Text(l10n.profilePrivacyDescription, style: muted),
+        ),
+        Material(
+          color: colors.base100,
+          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
+          clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
+          child: Column(
+            children: [
+              for (final key in keys) ...[
+                if (key != keys.first) const GfDivider(),
+                Semantics(
+                  value: profilePrivacyAudienceLabel(
+                    l10n,
+                    settings.audienceOf(key),
+                  ),
+                  child: GfSettingRow(
+                    key: ValueKey('profile-privacy-row-$key'),
+                    title: profilePrivacySectionLabel(l10n, key),
+                    description: _sectionDescription(l10n, key),
+                    trailing: _saving == key
+                        ? const SizedBox.square(
+                            dimension: 18,
+                            child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
+                          )
+                        : Row(
+                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
+                            children: [
+                              ConstrainedBox(
+                                constraints: const BoxConstraints(
+                                  maxWidth: 120,
+                                ),
+                                child: Text(
+                                  profilePrivacyAudienceLabel(
+                                    l10n,
+                                    settings.audienceOf(key),
+                                  ),
+                                  textAlign: TextAlign.end,
+                                  maxLines: 2,
+                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
+                                  style: type.small.copyWith(
+                                    color: colors.baseContent.withValues(
+                                      alpha: .7,
+                                    ),
+                                  ),
+                                ),
+                              ),
+                              const SizedBox(width: 4),
+                              GfSymbol(
+                                'chevron-right',
+                                size: 18,
+                                color: colors.iconMuted,
+                              ),
+                            ],
+                          ),
+                    onTap: _saving == null
+                        ? () => _choose(settings, key)
+                        : null,
+                  ),
+                ),
+              ],
+              // Bookmarks have no audience to choose: always only the owner.
+              // A fixed row keeps that from reading as public by omission.
+              const GfDivider(),
+              Semantics(
+                value: l10n.profilePrivacySelf,
+                child: GfSettingRow(
+                  key: const ValueKey('profile-privacy-row-bookmarks'),
+                  title: l10n.profileBookmarks,
+                  description: l10n.profilePrivacyBookmarksDescription,
+                  trailing: Row(
+                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
+                    children: [
+                      Text(
+                        l10n.profilePrivacySelf,
+                        style: type.small.copyWith(
+                          color: colors.baseContent.withValues(alpha: .7),
+                        ),
+                      ),
+                      const SizedBox(width: 4),
+                      // The chevron's slot, so the label lines up with the
+                      // editable rows above.
+                      SizedBox.square(
+                        dimension: 18,
+                        child: GfSymbol(
+                          'lock-filled',
+                          size: 14,
+                          color: colors.iconMuted,
+                        ),
+                      ),
+                    ],
+                  ),
+                ),
+              ),
+            ],
+          ),
+        ),
+        const SizedBox(height: 12),
+        Padding(
+          padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.symmetric(horizontal: 4),
+          child: Row(
+            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+            children: [
+              Padding(
+                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 1),
+                child: GfSymbol('info', size: 16, color: colors.iconMuted),
+              ),
+              const SizedBox(width: 8),
+              Expanded(child: Text(l10n.profilePrivacyScope, style: muted)),
+            ],
+          ),
+        ),
+        const SizedBox(height: 16),
+        Align(
+          alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerStart,
+          child: TextButton(
+            key: const ValueKey('profile-privacy-view-profile'),
+            onPressed: () => context.go('/profile'),
+            child: Text(l10n.profilePrivacyViewProfile),
+          ),
+        ),
+      ],
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+class _AudienceSheet extends StatelessWidget {
+  const _AudienceSheet({required this.section, required this.selected});
+  final String section;
+  final String selected;
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
+    final colors = GfTheme.colorsOf(context);
+    final type = GfTheme.typographyOf(context);
+    return SafeArea(
+      top: false,
+      child: SingleChildScrollView(
+        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(8, 0, 8, 12),
+        child: Column(
+          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
+          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
+          children: [
+            Padding(
+              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 4, 12, 8),
+              child: Text(
+                l10n.profilePrivacyAudienceTitle(
+                  profilePrivacySectionLabel(l10n, section),
+                ),
+                style: type.title3,
+              ),
+            ),
+            for (final audience in profilePrivacyAudiences[section]!)
+              Semantics(
+                selected: audience == selected,
+                child: GfSettingRow(
+                  key: ValueKey('profile-privacy-option-$audience'),
+                  title: profilePrivacyAudienceLabel(l10n, audience),
+                  trailing: audience == selected
+                      ? GfSymbol('check', size: 18, color: colors.primary)
+                      : const SizedBox.shrink(),
+                  onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(audience),
+                ),
+              ),
+          ],
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}

+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:ui_kit/ui_kit.dart';
+
+/// Tallest an embedded image may render inside an editor body: this fraction
+/// of the viewport height. The reader caps at `min(360px, 70vh)`; the editor
+/// keeps the same intent so a portrait photo cannot blow up the block height
+/// and push the caret far out of reach (issue #1122).
+const double kEditorEmbedImageMaxHeightFraction = 0.6;
+
+/// Sizing for a body image embed (Markdown image / composer photo) shared by
+/// every editor host.
+///
+/// Quill's inline embed layout bounds the width but leaves the height
+/// unbounded, so an image otherwise renders at its full intrinsic height
+/// (e.g. a 3:5 phone photo at full editor width). Images fill the editor width
+/// when wider than it and shrink proportionally under the height cap; both
+/// composer and editor render through this widget so a block keeps the same
+/// height everywhere it appears.
+class EditorEmbedImage extends StatelessWidget {
+  const EditorEmbedImage({super.key, required this.url});
+
+  final String url;
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final MediaQueryData media = MediaQuery.of(context);
+    return ConstrainedBox(
+      constraints: BoxConstraints(
+        maxHeight: media.size.height * kEditorEmbedImageMaxHeightFraction,
+      ),

+      // height tight to the image; the web prose centers images the same way.
+      child: Align(
+        alignment: Alignment.center,
+        heightFactor: 1,
+        child: GfNetworkImage(
+          url,
+          fit: BoxFit.contain,
+          cacheWidth: (media.size.width * media.devicePixelRatio).round(),
+          errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => const GfSymbol('image-off'),
+        ),
+      ),

+
+class _IdentityPickerState extends ConsumerState<IdentityPicker> {
+  Future<void> choose(String choice) async {
+    if (widget.disabled) return;

+      widget.onChanged(choice);

+    }
+    final epoch = ref.read(offlineCacheEpochProvider);

+                                  child: avatar,
+                                ),
+                              ),
+                              if (!widget.disabled)

+                size: 36,

+              checked: selected == 'member',

+                title: l.anonymousIdentity,
+                subtitle: l.anonymousSetup,
+                subtitleColor: colors.primary,
+                checked: false,
+                onTap: () => pick('setup'),

+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';

+import '../providers.dart';
+
+/// 外部链接预览卡片（服务端 `/api/link-previews/resolve` 的渲染端）。
+///
+/// 服务端只给标识与原文：平台名、资源类型徽标与作者称呼都由客户端按语言渲染
+/// （issue #1201，见 MADR 0094）。卡片与正文渲染分开，便于单独测试与复用。
+class GfLinkPreviewCard extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
+  const GfLinkPreviewCard({super.key, required this.preview});
+
+  final LinkPreviewPayload preview;
+
+  @override
+  ConsumerState<GfLinkPreviewCard> createState() => _GfLinkPreviewCardState();
+}
+
+class _GfLinkPreviewCardState extends ConsumerState<GfLinkPreviewCard> {
+  /// Web 端同一套档位：<480 不显示描述（小卡化最缺的正是垂直空间），
+  /// 480–639 一行，≥640 两行。
+  static int descriptionLinesFor(double cardWidth) =>
+      cardWidth < 480 ? 0 : (cardWidth < 640 ? 1 : 2);
+
+  bool _coverFailed = false;
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final LinkPreviewPayload preview = widget.preview;
+    final GfColors colors = GfTheme.colorsOf(context);
+    final GfBorders borders = GfTheme.bordersOf(context);
+    final GfRadii radii = GfTheme.radiiOf(context);
+    final String? coverUrl =
+        !_coverFailed && preview.imageUrl?.isNotEmpty == true
+        ? resolveApiAssetUrl(preview.imageUrl!)
+        : null;
+    final String? faviconUrl = preview.faviconUrl?.isNotEmpty == true
+        ? resolveApiAssetUrl(preview.faviconUrl!)
+        : null;
+    final AppLocalizations? l10n = Localizations.of<AppLocalizations>(
+      context,
+      AppLocalizations,
+    );
+    final LinkPreviewPlatformLabels platformLabels =
+        LinkPreviewPlatformLabels.of(l10n, preview);
+    // 来源名优先平台名（客户端按语言渲染），其次页面站点名，再回退 host。
+    final String sourceLabel = platformLabels.platform.isNotEmpty
+        ? platformLabels.platform
+        : (preview.siteName?.trim().isNotEmpty == true
+              ? preview.siteName!.trim()
+              : (preview.displayHost?.trim() ?? ''));
+    // #733 要求离开前能看到真实 host；与来源行是同一个字符串时不再重复占一行。
+    final String rawHost = preview.displayHost?.trim() ?? '';
+    final String hostLabel = rawHost.toLowerCase() == sourceLabel.toLowerCase()
+        ? ''
+        : rawHost;
+    // 校园网卡片由服务端按部署配置本地渲染：配置没给名字时 title / description
+    // 为空，兜底文案必须由客户端按语言出（服务端不留任何中文，issue #729）。
+    final String title = preview.title?.trim().isNotEmpty == true
+        ? preview.title!.trim()
+        : (preview.campus ? (l10n?.linkPreviewCampusFallbackTitle ?? '') : '');
+    final String description = preview.description?.trim().isNotEmpty == true
+        ? preview.description!.trim()
+        : (preview.campus
+              ? (l10n?.linkPreviewCampusFallbackDescription ?? '')
+              : '');
+
+    return LayoutBuilder(
+      builder: (BuildContext context, BoxConstraints constraints) {
+        final bool railCover = constraints.maxWidth >= 640;
+        final int descriptionLines = descriptionLinesFor(constraints.maxWidth);
+        // 封面走 Stack + Positioned，刻意不参与卡片高度计算：竖版封面若留在
+        // 文档流里，会按自身比例把整张卡片撑高（Web 端实测 164px → 362px）。
+        // <640px 是右上角 56px 方形缩略图；≥640px 是保留 16px 内边距的
+        // 168px 居中缩略图，宽屏使用 contain 完整显示，避免裁掉封面两端。
+        final double coverInset = railCover ? 16 : 14;
+        final double coverWidth = railCover ? 168 : 56;

+            ? 14
+            : (railCover ? coverWidth + 16 : 14 + coverWidth + 12);

+                          .round(),

+                          .round(),

+                  ),

+                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall
+                              ?.copyWith(
+                                color: colors.baseContent.withValues(alpha: 0.6),
+                              ),
+                        ),
+                      ),
+                      // 资源类型徽标只在严格识别出平台资源时出现（服务端
+                      // platform + resourceType），通用卡片上不会有它。
+                      if (platformLabels.resourceType.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
+                        const SizedBox(width: 6),
+                        Container(
+                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
+                            horizontal: 6,
+                            vertical: 2,
+                          ),
+                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
+                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
+                            border: Border.all(
+                              color: colors.line,
+                              width: borders.width,
+                            ),
+                          ),
+                          child: GfText(
+                            platformLabels.resourceType,
+                            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall
+                                ?.copyWith(
+                                  fontSize: 11,

+                                  color: colors.baseContent.withValues(

+                                  ),
+                                ),
+                          ),

+            if (sourceLabel.isNotEmpty) sourceLabel,
+          ].join(', '),
+          hint: preview.kind == 'external'
+              ? l10n?.linkPreviewExternalTitle
+              : null,
+          child: Padding(
+            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
+            child: Material(
+              color: colors.base100,
+              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
+                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radii.box),
+                side: BorderSide(color: colors.line, width: borders.width),
+              ),
+              clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
+              child: InkWell(
+                onTap: () => LinkNavigation.open(
+                  context,
+                  preview.url!,
+                  baseUrl: ref.read(apiClientProvider).baseUrl,
+                  previewKind: preview.kind,
+                ),
+                child: Stack(
+                  children: <Widget>[
+                    ConstrainedBox(
+                      // 缩略图绝对定位不参与高度计算，短卡片要自己留够 56 + 上下 14。
+                      constraints: BoxConstraints(
+                        minHeight: coverUrl != null && !railCover
+                            ? coverWidth + 28
+                            : 0,
+                      ),
+                      child: Padding(
+                        padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
+                          14,
+                          14,
+                          bodyRightPadding,
+                          14,
+                        ),
+                        child: body,
+                      ),
+                    ),
+                    if (coverUrl != null)
+                      Positioned(
+                        top: coverInset,
+                        right: coverInset,
+                        bottom: railCover ? coverInset : null,
+                        width: coverWidth,
+                        height: railCover ? null : coverWidth,
+                        child: ClipRRect(
+                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
+                          child: GfNetworkImage(
+                            coverUrl,
+                            fit: railCover ? BoxFit.contain : BoxFit.cover,
+                            cacheWidth:
+                                (coverWidth *
+                                        MediaQuery.devicePixelRatioOf(context))
+                                    .round(),
+                            cacheHeight:
+                                (coverWidth *
+                                        MediaQuery.devicePixelRatioOf(context))
+                                    .round(),
+                            errorBuilder: (_, _, _) {
+                              // 封面挂了就把让位空间一起收回，不留死白。
+                              WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
+                                if (mounted && !_coverFailed) {
+                                  setState(() => _coverFailed = true);
+                                }
+                              });
+                              return const SizedBox.shrink();
+                            },
+                          ),
+                        ),
+                      ),
+                  ],
+                ),
+              ),
+            ),
+          ),
+        );
+      },
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+/// 平台卡片的三段可见文案（平台名 / 资源类型 / 作者行）。
+///
+/// 服务端只给平台标识与作者原文，展示名与称呼由客户端按语言渲染；卡片与选择注
+/// 册表必须共用同一份取值逻辑，否则注册表会漏登记一段真实渲染出来的文本，复制
+/// 与 Emoji 占位符归属随之错位。
+class LinkPreviewPlatformLabels {
+  const LinkPreviewPlatformLabels({
+    required this.platform,
+    required this.resourceType,
+    required this.author,
+  });
+
+  factory LinkPreviewPlatformLabels.of(
+    AppLocalizations? l10n,
+    LinkPreviewPayload preview,
+  ) {
+    final String author = preview.author?.trim() ?? '';
+    return LinkPreviewPlatformLabels(
+      platform: switch (preview.platform) {
+        'bilibili' => l10n?.linkPreviewPlatformBilibili ?? '',
+        'apple_music' => l10n?.linkPreviewPlatformAppleMusic ?? '',
+        _ => '',
+      },
+      resourceType: switch (preview.resourceType) {
+        'video' => l10n?.linkPreviewResourceTypeVideo ?? '',
+        'song' => l10n?.linkPreviewResourceTypeSong ?? '',
+        'album' => l10n?.linkPreviewResourceTypeAlbum ?? '',
+        _ => '',
+      },
+      author: author.isEmpty
+          ? ''
+          : (preview.platform == 'apple_music'
+                ? (l10n?.linkPreviewAuthorArtist(author) ?? '')
+                : (l10n?.linkPreviewAuthorUploader(author) ?? '')),
+    );
+  }
+
+  final String platform;
+  final String resourceType;
+  final String author;
+
+  /// 卡片上会真实渲染的文本，供选择注册表预先登记。
+  List<String> get visible => <String>[
+    platform,
+    resourceType,
+    author,
+  ].where((String value) => value.isNotEmpty).toList(growable: false);
+}

+import 'dart:io';
+import 'dart:ui' as ui;
+import 'package:core/core.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/rendering.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:forum_app/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:forum_app/src/pages/settings/decoration_page.dart';
+import 'package:forum_app/src/providers.dart';
+import 'package:ui_kit/ui_kit.dart';
+import 'decoration_page_test.dart' show Decorations;
+import 'test_font_helpers.dart' show loadTestFonts;
+
+void main() {
+  testWidgets(
+    'administrator-configured sample art renders in the real decoration page',
+    (tester) async {
+      await loadTestFonts(tester);
+      final png = File(
+        '../../../../apps/gooseforum/resource/static/decorations/tea-garden-v1.png',
+      ).readAsBytesSync();
+      tester.view.physicalSize = const Size(860, 1800);
+      tester.view.devicePixelRatio = 2;
+      addTearDown(tester.view.resetPhysicalSize);
+      addTearDown(tester.view.resetDevicePixelRatio);
+      const catalog = [
+        DecorationStyle(
+          code: 'frame-garden',
+          name: '花园示例框',
+          kind: 'avatarFrame',
+          lightColors: ['#B45309', '#D97706'],
+          darkColors: ['#FCD34D', '#FDBA74'],
+          assetUrl: '/static/decorations/tea-garden-v1.png',
+        ),
+        DecorationStyle(
+          code: 'frame-sample',
+          name: '环形示例框',
+          kind: 'avatarFrame',
+          lightColors: ['#059669', '#0D9488'],
+          darkColors: ['#34D399', '#2DD4BF'],
+        ),
+        DecorationStyle(
+          code: 'name-garden',
+          name: '绿色昵称示例',
+          kind: 'nicknameStyle',
+          lightColors: ['#065F46', '#115E59'],
+          darkColors: ['#6EE7B7', '#99F6E4'],
+        ),
+        DecorationStyle(
+          code: 'name-sky',
+          name: '蓝色昵称示例',
+          kind: 'nicknameStyle',
+          lightColors: ['#1E40AF', '#3730A3'],
+          darkColors: ['#BFDBFE', '#DDD6FE'],
+        ),
+      ];
+      for (final brightness in [Brightness.light, Brightness.dark]) {
+        final repo = Decorations()
+          ..state = const DecorationState(
+            catalog: catalog,
+            ownedCodes: ['frame-garden', 'name-garden'],
+            avatarFrame: 'frame-garden',
+            nicknameStyle: 'name-garden',
+          );
+        final container = ProviderContainer(
+          overrides: [userRepositoryProvider.overrideWithValue(repo)],
+        );
+        final theme = gfThemeData(brightness);
+        final key = GlobalKey();
+        final actual = theme.copyWith(
+          textTheme: theme.textTheme.apply(fontFamily: 'NotoSansCJK'),
+          primaryTextTheme: theme.primaryTextTheme.apply(
+            fontFamily: 'NotoSansCJK',
+          ),
+          listTileTheme: theme.listTileTheme.copyWith(
+            titleTextStyle: theme.listTileTheme.titleTextStyle!.copyWith(
+              fontFamily: 'NotoSansCJK',
+            ),
+            subtitleTextStyle: theme.listTileTheme.subtitleTextStyle!.copyWith(
+              fontFamily: 'NotoSansCJK',
+            ),
+          ),
+        );
+        await tester.pumpWidget(
+          UncontrolledProviderScope(
+            container: container,
+            child: MaterialApp(
+              key: ValueKey(brightness),
+              theme: actual,
+              locale: const Locale('zh'),
+              localizationsDelegates: AppLocalizations.localizationsDelegates,
+              supportedLocales: AppLocalizations.supportedLocales,
+              home: GfMediaScope(
+                identity: brightness,
+                factory:
+                    (
+                      url, {
+                      width,
+                      height,
+                      policy = ResizeImagePolicy.exact,
+                      allowedOrigins,
+                    }) {
+                      expect(
+                        Uri.parse(url).path,
+                        '/static/decorations/tea-garden-v1.png',
+                      );
+                      return ResizeImage(
+                        MemoryImage(png),
+                        width: width,
+                        height: height,
+                        policy: policy,
+                      );
+                    },
+                child: RepaintBoundary(
+                  key: key,
+                  child: const DecorationPage(name: '同济校园 · 茶铃'),
+                ),
+              ),
+            ),
+          ),
+        );
+        await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+        await tester.runAsync(
+          () => Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 60)),
+        );
+        await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+        expect(tester.takeException(), isNull);
+        expect(tester.widget<RawImage>(find.byType(RawImage)).image, isNotNull);
+        final image = (await tester.runAsync(
+          () =>
+              (key.currentContext!.findRenderObject() as RenderRepaintBoundary)
+                  .toImage(pixelRatio: 2),
+        ))!;
+        final bytes = (await tester.runAsync(
+          () => image.toByteData(format: ui.ImageByteFormat.png),
+        ))!;
+        await tester.runAsync(
+          () => File(
+            '/tmp/yourtj-1156-mobile-${brightness.name}.png',
+          ).writeAsBytes(bytes.buffer.asUint8List()),
+        );
+        image.dispose();
+        container.dispose();
+      }
+    },
+  );
+}

new file mode 100644
index 000000000..5ec720305
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/mobile/packages/forum_app/test/temp_directory_helpers.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,69 @@
+import 'dart:async';
+import 'dart:io';
+
+/// Windows refuses to delete a file while any other process still has it open,
+/// and antivirus or indexer scans of files a test just wrote are enough to hold
+/// one for a moment. The delete of the whole directory then fails with a
+/// sharing violation (`PathAccessException`, errno 32) that clears by itself —
+/// see issue #1138. Delays double so a lock that clears quickly costs the suite
+/// almost nothing, while a slow scan is still covered.
+const _lockBackoff = <Duration>[
+  Duration(milliseconds: 25),
+  Duration(milliseconds: 50),
+  Duration(milliseconds: 100),
+  Duration(milliseconds: 200),
+  Duration(milliseconds: 400),
+  Duration(milliseconds: 800),
+  Duration(milliseconds: 1600),
+  Duration(milliseconds: 2000),
+  Duration(milliseconds: 2000),
+  Duration(milliseconds: 2000),
+  Duration(milliseconds: 2000),
+];
+
+/// Windows `ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION`, the errno a delete reports while another
+/// process holds a file in the directory open.
+const _sharingViolation = 32;
+
+/// Removes a test-owned temporary directory and everything in it.
+///
+/// Cleanup is scaffolding, not something a test asserts, so this helper never
+/// fails the test that owns the directory: a delete the OS refuses is retried
+/// while it reports a sharing violation (the antivirus or indexer scan of
+/// issue #1138), for about eleven seconds, and then — like any other failure —
+/// it is printed and the directory is left behind. That print is what keeps the
+/// failure mode visible: a handle the test itself leaked is exactly what makes
+/// the delete fail, and it still shows up in the output, it just does not turn
+/// into a test failure. A test that needs to prove its own handles are released
+/// should assert that directly instead of riding on delete semantics — macOS
+/// and Linux unlink open files happily, so this delete never had anything to
+/// say there anyway.
+///
+/// A directory that is already gone counts as cleaned up and prints nothing.
+Future<void> deleteTempDirectory(
+  Directory directory, {
+  List<Duration> backoff = _lockBackoff,
+}) async {
+  for (var attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
+    try {
+      await directory.delete(recursive: true);
+      return;
+    } on FileSystemException catch (error) {
+      if (error is PathNotFoundException) return;
+      if (!_isSharingViolation(error) || attempt >= backoff.length) {
+        // Cleanup reports belong in the test output, not in an app logger.
+        // ignore: avoid_print
+        print(
+          'deleteTempDirectory: leaving ${directory.path} behind after '
+          'cleanup failed ($error); the test result is not affected.',
+        );
+        return;
+      }
+      await Future<void>.delayed(backoff[attempt]);
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+bool _isSharingViolation(FileSystemException error) =>
+    error is PathAccessException &&
+    error.osError?.errorCode == _sharingViolation;

evidence.detail:
diff --git a/apps/mobile/packages/ui_kit/tool/generate_twemoji_manifest.mjs b/apps/mobile/packages/ui_kit/tool/generate_twemoji_manifest.mjs
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..d58d4a59d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/mobile/packages/ui_kit/tool/generate_twemoji_manifest.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,107 @@
+import { mkdir, readFile, readdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+import path from 'node:path'
+
+const scriptDir = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))
+const packageDir = path.resolve(scriptDir, '..')
+const imageDir = path.join(
+  packageDir,
+  'assets/twemoji-public/twemoji/72x72',
+)
+const manifestPath = path.join(packageDir, 'assets/twemoji-manifest.json')
+const dartMapPath = path.join(
+  packageDir,
+  'lib/src/twemoji/twemoji_asset_map.g.dart',
+)
+const version = '17.0.3'
+
+const files = (await readdir(imageDir))
+  .filter((file) => file.endsWith('.png'))
+  .filter((file) => {
+    const codepoint = Number.parseInt(file.split('-')[0], 16)
+    return !(codepoint >= 0xe000 && codepoint <= 0xf8ff)
+  })
+  .sort()
+
+const entriesBySequence = new Map()
+let maximumCodepoints = 0
+
+for (const file of files) {
+  const codepoints = file
+    .slice(0, -'.png'.length)
+    .split('-')
+    .map((hex) => Number.parseInt(hex, 16))
+
+  if (codepoints.some((codepoint) => !Number.isInteger(codepoint))) {
+    throw new Error(`Invalid Twemoji asset name: ${file}`)
+  }
+  // The upstream archive also carries one legacy Twitter bird PUA glyph. It
+  // is not a Unicode Emoji character and is outside this renderer's scope.
+  if (codepoints.some((codepoint) => codepoint >= 0xe000 && codepoint <= 0xf8ff)) {
+    continue
+  }
+
+  const sequence = String.fromCodePoint(...codepoints)
+  const hasJoiner = codepoints.includes(0x200d)
+  const canonicalCodepoints = hasJoiner
+    ? codepoints
+    : codepoints.filter((codepoint) => codepoint !== 0xfe0f)
+  const canonicalSequence = String.fromCodePoint(...canonicalCodepoints)
+  const existing = entriesBySequence.get(canonicalSequence)
+
+  if (existing && existing.asset !== file) {
+    throw new Error(
+      `Twemoji assets map to the same sequence: ${existing.asset}, ${file}`,
+    )
+  }
+
+  entriesBySequence.set(canonicalSequence, { sequence: canonicalSequence, asset: file })
+  maximumCodepoints = Math.max(maximumCodepoints, codepoints.length)
+  if (sequence.includes('\u200d')) {
+    maximumCodepoints = Math.max(maximumCodepoints, Array.from(sequence).length)
+  }
+}
+
+const entries = [...entriesBySequence.values()].sort((left, right) =>
+  left.sequence < right.sequence ? -1 : left.sequence > right.sequence ? 1 : 0,
+)
+const manifest = `${JSON.stringify({ version, entries }, null, 2)}\n`
+const dartMap = [
+  '// GENERATED CODE - DO NOT MODIFY BY HAND.',
+  '// Regenerate with: node tool/generate_twemoji_manifest.mjs',
+  `const String twemojiAssetVersion = '${version}';`,
+  `const int twemojiMaximumCodepoints = ${maximumCodepoints + 4};`,
+  'const Map<String, String> twemojiAssetBySequence = <String, String>{',
+  ...entries.map(({ sequence, asset }) => {
+    const entry = `  '${sequence}': '${asset}',`
+    return entry.length > 80
+      ? `  '${sequence}':\n      '${asset}',`
+      : entry
+  }),
+  '};',
+  '',
+].join('\n')
+
+const checkOnly = process.argv.includes('--check')
+
+async function writeOrCheck(filePath, expected) {
+  let actual
+  try {
+    actual = await readFile(filePath, 'utf8')
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (checkOnly || error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error
+  }
+
+  if (actual === expected) return
+  if (checkOnly) {
+    throw new Error(`${path.relative(packageDir, filePath)} is stale; regenerate it`)
+  }
+  await writeFile(filePath, expected)
+}
+
+await mkdir(path.dirname(dartMapPath), { recursive: true })
+await writeOrCheck(manifestPath, manifest)
+await writeOrCheck(dartMapPath, dartMap)
+console.log(
+  `Twemoji ${version}: ${files.length} PNGs, ${entries.length} mapped sequences${checkOnly ? ' (checked)' : ''}`,
+)

+import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
+
+/// Selects the platform-specific passkey capability probe without invoking any
+/// platform API on unsupported targets.
+Future<bool> resolvePasskeyAvailability({
+  required bool isWeb,
+  required TargetPlatform platform,
+  required Future<bool> Function() web,
+  required Future<bool> Function() android,
+  required Future<bool> Function() ios,
+}) {
+  if (isWeb) return web();
+  return switch (platform) {
+    TargetPlatform.android => android(),
+    TargetPlatform.iOS => ios(),
+    _ => Future<bool>.value(false),
+  };
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
+
+/// campus 隐私内容的前台判定：仅 paused/hidden/detached 视为被覆盖——此时
+/// 丢弃隐私子树、suspend 数据、冲刷内存缓存。inactive（通知栏、控制中心、
+/// 来电等瞬时遮挡，内容仍在屏上）不触发重建，避免每次遮挡都整页骨架屏
+/// 重载。
+///
+/// 取舍：Flutter 自 hidden/paused 起停用帧调度，卸载产生的空白帧不会绘制，
+/// 应用切换器缩略图可能保留含隐私内容的最后一帧；恢复前台仍先核验绑定再
+/// 取数。取舍与备选方案见 MADR 0092。
+bool isCampusForeground(AppLifecycleState? state) =>
+    state == null ||
+    state == AppLifecycleState.resumed ||
+    state == AppLifecycleState.inactive;

+/// Review result for one rejected or pending item, with the appeal entry and

+Future<ContentReviewAction?> showContentReviewSheet(
+  BuildContext context,
+  UserContentItem item, {

+class ContentReviewSheet extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
+  const ContentReviewSheet({

+class _ContentReviewSheetState extends ConsumerState<ContentReviewSheet> {
+  final TextEditingController _reason = TextEditingController();

+        _epoch != ref.read(offlineCacheEpochProvider)) {
+      return;
+    }
+    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
+    setState(() {
+      _busy = true;
+      _error = null;
+    });
+    try {
+      await ref.read(contentRepositoryProvider).submitAppeal(widget.item, text);
+      if (!mounted || _epoch != ref.read(offlineCacheEpochProvider)) return;
+      showGfToast(context, l10n.appealSubmitted);
+      Navigator.of(context).pop(ContentReviewAction.appealed);
+    } catch (error) {
+      // 业务失败说明具体原因；网络失败提示重试，输入的理由保留在框里。
+      if (mounted) {
+        setState(
+          () => _error =
+              error is ApiException && (error.messageCode ?? '').isNotEmpty
+              ? resolveErrorMessage(l10n, error)
+              : l10n.appealSubmitFailed,

+      }

+          child: Column(

+                  style: type.small.copyWith(color: muted),
+                  maxLines: 2,
+                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,

+              ],

+              Wrap(
+                spacing: 6,
+                runSpacing: 6,
+                children: [
+                  item.processStatus == 1
+                      ? GfBadge(
+                          label: l10n.contentReviewBlocked,
+                          variant: GfBadgeVariant.error,
+                        )
+                      : GfBadge(
+                          label: l10n.contentReviewPending,
+                          variant: GfBadgeVariant.warning,
+                        ),
+                ],
+              ),
+              if (item.processStatus == 1 && item.reviewReason.isNotEmpty) ...[
+                const SizedBox(height: 12),
+                GfText(
+                  l10n.contentReviewReasonLabel,
+                  style: type.caption.copyWith(color: muted),
+                ),
+                const SizedBox(height: 2),
+                GfText(item.reviewReason, style: type.body),
+              ],
+              if (item.hasPublishedVersion) ...[
+                const SizedBox(height: 8),
+                GfText(
+                  l10n.contentReviewLive,
+                  style: type.small.copyWith(color: muted),
+                ),
+              ],
+              if (item.appeal != null) ...[
+                const SizedBox(height: 16),
+                AppealStateCard(appeal: item.appeal!),
+              ],
+              AnimatedSize(
+                duration: GfMotion.duration(context, GfMotion.layout),
+                curve: GfMotion.enterCurve,
+                alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
+                child: _appealing
+                    ? _AppealForm(
+                        controller: _reason,
+                        enabled: !_busy && !stale,
+                        busy: _busy,
+                        error: _error,
+                        onChanged: () => setState(() => _error = null),
+                        onCancel: () => setState(() {
+                          _appealing = false;
+                          _error = null;
+                        }),
+                        onSubmit: _submit,
+                      )
+                    : const SizedBox(width: double.infinity),
+              ),
+              if (!_appealing) ...[
+                const SizedBox(height: 20),
+                Wrap(

+                    ),
+                    if (_canAppeal)
+                      GfButton(
+                        key: const Key('appeal-start'),
+                        label: l10n.appealAction,
+                        icon: const GfSymbol('undo-2', size: 16),
+                        variant: GfButtonVariant.secondary,
+                        size: GfButtonSize.small,

+/// Progress of the appeal on the latest revision.
+class AppealStateCard extends StatelessWidget {
+  const AppealStateCard({super.key, required this.appeal});
+
+  final ModerationAppealOwnerSummary appeal;
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
+    final colors = GfTheme.colorsOf(context);
+    final type = GfTheme.typographyOf(context);
+    final muted = colors.baseContent.withValues(alpha: 0.6);
+    final (
+      String symbol,
+      Color tone,
+      String title,
+      String body,
+    ) = switch (appeal.status) {
+      'approved' => (
+        'circle-check',
+        colors.success,
+        l10n.appealStateApprovedTitle,
+        l10n.appealStateApprovedBody,
+      ),
+      'rejected' => (
+        'circle-alert',
+        colors.error,
+        l10n.appealStateRejectedTitle,
+        l10n.appealStateRejectedBody,
+      ),
+      'stale' => (
+        'circle',
+        colors.iconMuted,
+        l10n.appealStateStaleTitle,
+        l10n.appealStateStaleBody,
+      ),
+      _ => (
+        'clock',
+        colors.warning,
+        l10n.appealStatePendingTitle,
+        l10n.appealStatePendingBody,
+      ),

+    final times = [
+      l10n.appealSubmittedAt(timeAgo(appeal.createdAt, l10n: l10n)),

+                const SizedBox(height: 4),

+                    ),
+                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
+                      color: colors.base100,
+                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(
+                        GfTheme.radiiOf(context).field,
+                      ),
+                    ),
+                    child: Column(
+                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+                      children: [
+                        GfText(

+                              ? appeal.reviewReason
+                              : l10n.appealNoReviewerNote,
+                          style: type.small,
+                        ),
+                      ],
+                    ),
+                  ),
+                ],
+                const SizedBox(height: 10),
+                GfText(
+                  l10n.appealYourReason,
+                  style: type.caption.copyWith(color: muted),
+                ),
+                const SizedBox(height: 2),
+                GfText(
+                  appeal.reason,
+                  style: type.small,
+                  maxLines: 4,
+                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,

+                const SizedBox(height: 8),
+                GfText(times, style: type.caption.copyWith(color: muted)),
+              ],
+            ),
+          ),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+class _AppealForm extends StatelessWidget {
+  const _AppealForm({
+    required this.controller,
+    required this.enabled,
+    required this.busy,
+    required this.error,
+    required this.onChanged,
+    required this.onCancel,
+    required this.onSubmit,
+  });
+
+  final TextEditingController controller;
+  final bool enabled;
+  final bool busy;
+  final String? error;
+  final VoidCallback onChanged;
+  final VoidCallback onCancel;
+  final VoidCallback onSubmit;
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
+    final colors = GfTheme.colorsOf(context);
+    final type = GfTheme.typographyOf(context);
+    final length = controller.text.runes.length;
+    return Padding(
+      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 16),
+      child: Column(
+        key: const Key('appeal-form'),
+        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
+        children: [
+          GfText(l10n.appealFormTitle, style: type.bodyStrong),
+          const SizedBox(height: 4),
+          GfText(
+            l10n.appealFormIntro,
+            style: type.small.copyWith(
+              color: colors.baseContent.withValues(alpha: 0.6),
+            ),
+          ),
+          const SizedBox(height: 12),
+          TextField(
+            controller: controller,
+            enabled: enabled,
+            autofocus: true,
+            minLines: 3,
+            maxLines: 6,
+            textInputAction: TextInputAction.newline,
+            inputFormatters: const [
+              _RuneLengthLimitingFormatter(appealReasonMaxLength),
+            ],
+            onChanged: (_) => onChanged(),
+            decoration: InputDecoration(
+              labelText: l10n.appealReasonLabel,
+              hintText: l10n.appealReasonPlaceholder,
+              alignLabelWithHint: true,
+              helperText: l10n.appealOncePerVersion,
+              errorText: error,
+              errorMaxLines: 4,
+              counterText: '$length/$appealReasonMaxLength',
+            ),
+          ),
+          const SizedBox(height: 12),
+          Row(
+            children: [
+              Expanded(
+                child: GfButton(
+                  label: l10n.commonCancel,
+                  variant: GfButtonVariant.secondary,
+                  onPressed: busy ? null : onCancel,
+                  expanded: true,
+                ),
+              ),
+              const SizedBox(width: 12),
+              Expanded(
+                child: GfButton(
+                  key: const Key('appeal-submit'),
+                  label: l10n.appealSubmit,
+                  loading: busy,
+                  expanded: true,
+                  onPressed: !enabled || controller.text.trim().isEmpty
+                      ? null
+                      : onSubmit,
+                ),
+              ),
+            ],
+          ),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+class _RuneLengthLimitingFormatter extends TextInputFormatter {
+  const _RuneLengthLimitingFormatter(this.maxLength);
+
+  final int maxLength;
+
+  @override
+  TextEditingValue formatEditUpdate(
+    TextEditingValue oldValue,
+    TextEditingValue newValue,
+  ) {
+    final runes = newValue.text.runes;
+    if (runes.length <= maxLength) return newValue;
+    final text = String.fromCharCodes(runes.take(maxLength));
+    final offset = newValue.selection.baseOffset.clamp(0, text.length);
+    return newValue.copyWith(
+      text: text,
+      selection: TextSelection.collapsed(offset: offset),
+      composing: TextRange.empty,
+    );
+  }
+}

+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
+import 'package:ui_kit/ui_kit.dart';
+import '../../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../asset_url.dart';
+
+/// Shared collapsing cover, avatar and navigation for member/persona profiles.
+class ProfileHeaderSliver extends StatelessWidget {
+  const ProfileHeaderSliver({
+    super.key,
+    required this.avatarUrl,
+    this.avatarFrameColors = const [],
+    this.avatarFrameAssetUrl = '',
+    this.avatarFrameScale = 1.25,
+    required this.title,
+    this.coverUrl = '',
+    this.avatarBadge,
+    this.actions,
+    this.actionHeightFor,
+    this.navigationActions,
+  });
+  final String avatarUrl, coverUrl;
+  final List<Color> avatarFrameColors;
+  final String avatarFrameAssetUrl;
+  final double avatarFrameScale;
+  final Widget title;
+  final Widget? avatarBadge, actions;
+  final double Function(BuildContext, double)? actionHeightFor;
+  final List<Widget> Function(BuildContext, bool)? navigationActions;
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) => SliverLayoutBuilder(
+    builder: (context, constraints) {
+      final colors = GfTheme.colorsOf(context);
+      final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
+      final topInset = MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).top;
+      final width = constraints.crossAxisExtent;
+      final coverHeight = GfUserCard.coverHeightFor(width, topInset: topInset);
+      bool expanded(BuildContext context) {
+        final settings = context
+            .dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<FlexibleSpaceBarSettings>();
+        return settings == null ||
+            settings.currentExtent > settings.minExtent + 12;
+      }
+
+      final actionHeight =
+          actionHeightFor?.call(context, width) ??
+          GfUserCardHeader.actionHeightFor(MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context));
+      return SliverAppBar(
+        key: const Key('profile-cover-navigation'),
+        pinned: true,
+        expandedHeight: coverHeight + actionHeight - topInset,
+        toolbarHeight: 56,
+        elevation: 0,
+        scrolledUnderElevation: 0,
+        backgroundColor: colors.base100,
+        foregroundColor: colors.baseContent,
+        automaticallyImplyLeading: false,
+        centerTitle: false,
+        titleSpacing: Navigator.canPop(context) ? 0 : 16,
+        titleTextStyle: TextStyle(
+          color: colors.baseContent,
+          fontSize: 18,
+          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
+        ),
+        leadingWidth: 64,
+        leading: Navigator.canPop(context)
+            ? Builder(
+                builder: (context) => Padding(
+                  padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(
+                    start: 12,
+                    top: 6,
+                    bottom: 6,
+                  ),
+                  child: expanded(context)
+                      ? GfGlassIconButton(
+                          symbol: 'arrow-left',
+                          tooltip: l10n.commonBack,
+                          onPressed: () => Navigator.maybePop(context),
+                        )
+                      : GfIconButton(
+                          symbol: 'arrow-left',
+                          tooltip: l10n.commonBack,
+                          onPressed: () => Navigator.maybePop(context),
+                        ),
+                ),
+              )
+            : null,
+        title: Builder(
+          builder: (context) =>
+              expanded(context) ? const SizedBox.shrink() : title,
+        ),
+        actions: [
+          Builder(
+            builder: (context) => Padding(
+              padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(end: 12),
+              child: Row(
+                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
+                spacing: 8,
+                children:
+                    navigationActions?.call(context, expanded(context)) ??
+                    const <Widget>[],
+              ),
+            ),
+          ),
+        ],
+        flexibleSpace: Builder(
+          builder: (context) {
+            final isExpanded = expanded(context);
+            return AnnotatedRegion<SystemUiOverlayStyle>(
+              value:
+                  isExpanded || Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark
+                  ? SystemUiOverlayStyle.light
+                  : SystemUiOverlayStyle.dark,
+              child: Stack(
+                fit: StackFit.expand,
+                children: [
+                  FlexibleSpaceBar(
+                    collapseMode: CollapseMode.pin,
+                    // Keep the cover, complete avatar and action band in the same
+                    // sliver; a negative overflow into a later sliver is occluded.
+                    background: IgnorePointer(
+                      ignoring: !isExpanded,
+                      child: ExcludeSemantics(
+                        excluding: !isExpanded,
+                        child: GfUserCardHeader(
+                          avatarFrameColors: avatarFrameColors,
+                          avatarFrameAssetUrl: avatarFrameAssetUrl,
+                          avatarFrameScale: avatarFrameScale,
+                          coverHeight: coverHeight,
+                          actionHeight: actionHeight,
+                          coverUrl: resolveApiAssetUrl(coverUrl),
+                          avatarUrl: resolveApiAssetUrl(avatarUrl),
+                          avatarBadge: avatarBadge,
+                          actions: actions,
+                        ),
+                      ),
+                    ),
+                  ),
+                  if (isExpanded)
+                    Positioned(
+                      left: 0,
+                      right: 0,
+                      top: 0,
+                      height: topInset + 64,
+                      child: const IgnorePointer(
+                        child: DecoratedBox(
+                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
+                            gradient: LinearGradient(
+                              begin: Alignment.topCenter,
+                              end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
+                              colors: [
+                                Color(0x99000000),
+                                Color(0x88000000),
+                                Colors.transparent,
+                              ],
+                              stops: [0, .6, 1],
+                            ),
+                          ),
+                        ),
+                      ),
+                    ),
+                ],
+              ),
+            );
+          },
+        ),
+      );
+    },
+  );
+}

+/// Content-type choice above the composer: a quiet track whose raised pill
+/// slides to the chosen type. A null [onChanged] locks the choice (existing
+/// topics, pending uploads) while keeping the current type readable.
+class PublishTypeSwitcher extends StatelessWidget {
+  const PublishTypeSwitcher({
+    super.key,
+    required this.value,
+    required this.onChanged,
+  });
+  final int value;
+  final ValueChanged<int>? onChanged;
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
+    final colors = GfTheme.colorsOf(context);
+    final type = GfTheme.typographyOf(context);
+    final enabled = onChanged != null;
+    final duration = GfMotion.duration(context, GfMotion.layout);
+    final index = PublishType.values.indexWhere((t) => t.value == value);
+    return Container(

+              alignment: AlignmentDirectional(
+                index * 2 / (PublishType.values.length - 1) - 1,

+                widthFactor: 1 / PublishType.values.length,

+                    boxShadow: [

+                        color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: .06),

+                        offset: const Offset(0, 1),
+                      ),
+                    ],
+                  ),
+                ),
+              ),
+            ),
+          ),
+          Row(
+            children: [
+              for (final item in PublishType.values)
+                Expanded(
+                  child: Semantics(
+                    key: Key('publish-type-${item.value}'),
+                    button: true,
+                    selected: item.value == value,
+                    enabled: enabled,
+                    child: InkWell(
+                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(13),
+                      onTap: enabled && item.value != value
+                          ? () => onChanged!(item.value)
+                          : null,
+                      child: ConstrainedBox(
+                        constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 40),
+                        child: Padding(
+                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
+                            horizontal: 6,
+                            vertical: 8,
+                          ),
+                          child: _SegmentLabel(
+                            symbol: item.symbol,
+                            label: item.label(l10n),
+                            duration: duration,
+                            iconColor: item.value == value

+                                    alpha: enabled ? 1 : .5,

+                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
+                              color: item.value == value
+                                  ? colors.baseContent
